kitEvidence.formula:
Begin Charging: Irelia enters a defensive stance for up to [1.5 / 1.5 / 1.5 / 1.5 / 1.5] seconds, becoming unable to act but reducing physical damage taken by [characterLevelInterpolation(40 → 70; raw flags preserved) + (0.08) × AP]% and magic damage taken by [(characterLevelInterpolation(40 → 70; raw flags preserved) + (0.08) × AP) × (0.5)]%.

Release: Irelia lashes out with her blades, dealing [10 / 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 + (0.4) × AD + (0.5) × AP] physical damage increased up to [30 / 60 / 90 / 120 / 150 + (1.2) × AD + (1.5) × AP] based on charge time.

builds.name: Flawless Duet: AP blade intersection

builds.goal: Investigate high one Flawless Duet crossing output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: E deals 70/110/150/190/230 + 1.0 AP magic once when the two blades converge. The second placement creates the crossing; it is not a second independent full damage hit. The mark and stun enable follow-up actions but are not extra E damage.

Irelia throws a blade into the ground and can Recast for up to [3.5 / 3.5 / 3.5 / 3.5 / 3.5] seconds.

builds.name: Vanguard's Edge: projectile and one wall crossing
builds.summary: Investigate high one Vanguard's Edge projectile and boundary hit output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one Vanguard's Edge projectile and boundary hit output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: R projectile and cage boundary each use 125/200/275 + 1.0 AP magic. One legal hit of each at rank 3 nominally totals 550 + 2.0 AP. Cage creation is not automatically a second hit on every enclosed victim, and Unsteady marks do not themselves add Q damage to R.
